How to update these rankings
1
Add stats in Excel
In your Draft Project workbook, fill in raw CBB Reference stats for any prospect. Your formulas calculate the Metric automatically.
2
Refresh the dashboard
Click File ▾ → Refresh from Excel and upload your updated .xlsx. Every tab — including this one — updates instantly.
3
Rankings update live
New metric scores appear here sorted highest to lowest. Pending players move up when their stats come in. Export anytime to CSV.
